title: Towards Sustainable Learning in Online Education: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2608.11245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online education offers unprecedented scalability and accessibility to global learners from diverse backgrounds, but it often suffers from low engagement and poor long term learning effectiveness. To address these challenges, we introduce AI Tutor, a reinforcement learning based model designed to promote sustainable learning by optimizing both short and longterm learning outcomes. In the short term, AI-Tutor draws on cognitive theory to guide learners through a balance of acquiring new knowledge and reinforcing prior learning. In the long term, it models learner engagement to inform strategies that sustain motivation and reduce dropout. These enhancements enable AI-Tutor to provide personalized guidance that fosters both effective learning and sustained participation. translated_title: 在线教育中迈向可持续学习：一种强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 在线教育为来自不同背景的全球学习者提供了前所未有的可扩展性和可及性，但往往面临参与度低和长期学习效果不佳的问题。为应对这些挑战，我们引入了AI Tutor，一种基于强化学习的模型，旨在通过优化短期和长期学习成果来促进可持续学习。在短期内，AI-Tutor借鉴认知理论，引导学习者在获取新知识与巩固先前学习之间取得平衡。在长期内，它建模学习者参与度，以制定维持动机和减少辍学的策略。这些增强功能使AI-Tutor能够提供个性化指导，促进有效学习和持续参与。对来自33,700名学习者的2300万条学习记录进行的实证评估表明，AI Tutor在参与度、知识掌握等方面始终优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的AI Tutor模型，通过平衡短期知识获取与长期参与度建模，显著提升了在线教育的可持续学习效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning-based AI Tutor model that balances short-term knowledge acquisition with long-term engagement modeling, significantly enhancing sustainable learning outcomes in online education.
